description: A brilliant, resilient alternate persona with exceptional agility, technical skill, and danger awareness. Faithful but emotionally distant, he relies on calculation over empathy.
A strong, relentless fighter whose courage and aggression make him dangerous up close. He often rushes into danger without thinking.
An imaginative and perceptive anime enthusiast with strong creative and technical talent. Poor focus and shaky composure can limit her potential.
A mischievous, charismatic character who learns quickly and adapts easily. Her sharp perception and remarkable stamina make her surprisingly formidable.
A meticulous and quietly funny thinker with exceptional intelligence, memory, and determination. He notices details others miss but struggles with social intuition and sudden change.
An intelligent, perceptive strategist with strong resilience and physical ability. He prefers calculated pressure and psychological leverage over reckless confrontation.
A charismatic and highly resilient personality who refuses to stay down. Fiercely assertive, she can become aggressive and underestimate danger when provoked.
A strong, energetic, and creative character with impressive technical ability. He improvises well but struggles with focus, commitment, and adapting when his first plan fails.
A nimble and courageous physical talent with excellent balance and composure. He relies heavily on instinct, leaving him vulnerable to traps and poor risk assessment.
A resourceful all-rounder with strong charisma, determination, and technical competence. He excels at problem-solving, negotiation, and persistence.
A daring explorer with excellent coordination, balance, and courage. Creative and engaging, he struggles with focus and may value freedom over loyalty.
A powerful and relentless operator built around strength, stamina, aggression, and deception. Fiercely loyal to allies, he shows little empathy toward outsiders.
A cautious intellectual with exceptional memory and risk awareness. Slow and physically awkward, she relies on planning and technical knowledge.
A disciplined and composed natural commander with strong intelligence, focus, and tactical awareness. Loyal and honest, he succeeds through preparation rather than deception.
Principled diplomat with strong faith, empathy, and conversational skill.
Imposing enforcer with high strength, loyalty, and tactical discipline.
